title: Applicant portal workflow
baseline: Already confirmed: verified accounts, isolated applicant data, private drafts, original/history preservation, case messages and notices, testimony Confirm/Reject, applicant-only appeal supplements, and explicit decree release. These remain the baseline. The future marriage portal is outside this review.
sections: home
Portal home & case navigation
What the applicant sees first.
Should the portal home show the applicant’s current case, unfinished draft and any pending appeal together?
Show only that applicant’s permitted records; a pending appeal may relate to the same case.
Should closed cases appear in a separate past-cases list?
The list would show reference/status and permitted messages, appeals and released certificates, not unlock original closed questionnaire/evidence.
Should each case have an applicant-facing timeline of key events?
For example submitted, returned, accepted, assigned, hearing update, decision, appeal and closure. Exclude internal notes, votes and deliberations.
Should the home page prioritize actions the applicant needs to take?
For example complete a draft, address returned items, respond to an invitation or read a new request.
Should an applicant see a clear “case is closed” explanation before the appeal option?
Explain that an appeal is a new-information submission, not ordinary editing of the original case.
applications
Applications & corrections
Turn confirmed application rules into portal behavior.
Should a draft show a section checklist of missing required answers and documents?
The USD 250 fee remains disclosed before starting and payment stays at the completed-application end.
Should the applicant see a full review of their answers and attachments before signing and paying?
This reviews only their own submission; neither spouse’s answers overwrite the other’s.
Should returned applications open directly to the reviewer’s correction instructions and relevant form areas?
Keep original answers/history; do not add another filing fee or require a new signature for corrections.
Should an applicant’s post-submission correction to one field become an explicit Save action for that field or section?
Use Other to prefer automatic saving. No reason or re-signing is required, and every committed change is retained.
Should draft-expiry warnings also appear inside the portal?
The existing 180-day inactivity expiry and seven-day email warning remain; this asks only about an on-screen warning.
requests
Requests for information
How council requests are presented to the applicant.
Should a council request for information appear as a separate actionable item with an applicant response area?
The current message history remains authoritative; this would link responses to the request without creating a private chat feature.
Should the applicant be able to add documents directly when responding to a request while the case is open?
Uploads stay inside the portal with existing ownership, limits and history; no email attachment submissions.
Should council mark a request resolved after reviewing the response?
If No, the exchange can remain ordinary recorded correspondence with no separate request status.
Should applicants be able to send a new case message from the portal, in addition to replying to existing case emails?
This would be recorded case correspondence, not live chat. The sender cannot contact the other applicant or expose their own private data to them.
Should portal replies and email replies appear in one private conversation history for that applicant?
Use Other if you want portal read-only correspondence and email-only replies. Staff sees the authorized case communication record.
files
Documents & fees
Convenience within the approved access boundaries.
Should the document area group the applicant’s latest files by document category?
Applicants still cannot browse older attachment versions or the other party’s files.
Should a replacement upload clearly show which existing document it will replace?
Preserve the original in council-only version history; ordinary replacement is available only in the permitted open proceeding.
Should the portal show the applicant’s own payment/waiver status and receipt for each filing?
Do not show the other party’s payments or internal waiver administration; no applicant waiver-request option.
Should applicants be able to download their individual payment receipt?
This is a receipt, not a case-record export. Use Other if the provider receipt alone is sufficient.
hearings
Appointments & notifications
Applicant visibility without council-session access.
Should upcoming testimony invitations appear in a dedicated appointments area?
Date, time, instructions and Confirm/Reject are already agreed; no applicant rescheduling and no private council agenda access.
Should the portal show a map/address or remote attendance link supplied by staff for testimony?
Only for that applicant’s own appointment. CTM is not required to host video calls merely by storing a link.
Should the applicant receive an automatic reminder one day before their testimony appointment?
Use Other to specify a different interval, channels or no reminders. Initial/change invitations already use portal/email.
Should notifications distinguish unread from read and allow the applicant to mark them read?
This affects the applicant’s inbox state only, not proof of legal service or changes to case records.
appeals
Appeals & certificates
Portal actions after a decision.
Should the appeal page display the applicant’s appeal statement, additions, fee status and council Accept/Decline result together?
Only their own appeal information; the other applicant’s appeal evidence remains private.
Should adding appeal information display a chronological list of the applicant’s prior supplements?
These are retained additions, not edits to the originally submitted appeal statement.
Should withdrawal require a short confirmation screen before taking effect?
No approval or withdrawal reason is added. The screen explains the applicable case/appeal effect and nonrefundable fee.
Should a decree notice show that the certificate is not yet available until staff releases it?
No download link or certificate preview before explicit release; the detailed handover process remains a separate discussion.
Should a released certificate display its decree ID, language and release date next to View / Download?
Access remains exact-recipient/current-released-version only; earlier certificate versions stay hidden.
profile
Profile & preferences
No new authentication policy.
Should applicants manage their notification language and verified email change inside an account settings page?
English/Arabic preference and verified email changes are already approved; this asks where those actions live.
Should updating account contact information leave submitted case answers unchanged until the applicant explicitly corrects the permitted case fields?
Keep account data and signed submission assertions distinct; no retroactive rewrite of past applications.
